classification_semantics.BUILD: There is a justified active successor, but it must be versioned/frozen before outcome access.
classification_semantics.MERGE: A verified implementation exists but canonical integration is the remaining gate.
classification_semantics.ONE_FINAL_TEST: Source/protocol are otherwise closed and one decisive preregistered test remains.
classification_semantics.FREEZE_NEGATIVE: The current frozen scientific question is closed negative/falsified and must not be rescue-tuned.
classification_semantics.ARCHIVE: The current bounded implementation/result is complete at its supported scope; stronger science is a separate successor, not unfinished work on the old result.
classification_semantics.BLOCKED: A real provenance/source/identity dependency prevents safe execution; do not reconstruct or guess.
